source.name: Charlotte FC: 'Charlotte FC Expands Partnership with Rugs.com'
source.quote: Rugs.com will become the Club’s official sleeve partner and debut during Charlotte FC’s match on Wednesday against Inter Miami CF.
source.note: Club announcement describes a multi-year deal making Rugs.com a Founding-Level partner and official kit sleeve partner; no deal value was reported.

note: Multi-year sleeve deal announced 2024-07-02; Rugs.com had partnered with the club from the start of the 2024 season. The 2026 kit release confirms the sleeve placement for a third season.
